preparedCli.childIsolation: Use process.execPath with a Node 22/24 guard and prepend its directory to a minimal child PATH. Isolated HOME and cwd are newly created private fixture directories. No host credentials or environment are copied. Strict mode remains enabled.
preparedCli.transport: Node child preloads a throwing HTTP/HTTPS/net/TLS/DNS/UDP/fetch/WebSocket denial guard. It returns no canned result. NODE_OPTIONS carries the same guard to inherited Node children.
preparedCli.secrets: The child environment contains only the newly issued fixture license and public key, never its private key. Canonical fixture/command manifests contain environment key names, statuses, arguments, paths and exact file/stream hashes, not raw license or environment values. Raw stdout/stderr stay private. If a token appears in output, the test throws a generic error rather than quoting the token into canonical failure output.
